description: This Swift source file defines a factory for creating and managing NSPanel and NSWindow objects with custom animations and behaviors on macOS. It includes methods to create panels, animate their presentation and dismissal, and manage window appearance and events.

methods.name: makePanel
methods.description: Creates a configured NSPanel with specified properties such as content rectangle, window level, shadow, and mouse event acceptance.

methods.name: animatePresent
methods.description: Animates the presentation of a window from a start frame to a target frame with fade-in effect.

methods.name: animateFrame
methods.description: Animates moving a window to a target frame.

methods.name: applyFrame
methods.description: Sets the window's frame to a target, optionally with animation.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Handles presenting a window with optional animation and callbacks for first-time or subsequent displays.

methods.name: animateDismiss
methods.description: Animates the dismissal of a window by offsetting its frame and fading out, with a completion callback.

methods.name: animateDismissAndHide
methods.description: Performs dismiss animation and then hides (orders out) the window, invoking an onHidden callback.

methods.name: clearGlobalEventMonitor
methods.description: Removes an existing global event monitor if present.
